主要内容: This report is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, a Canadian financial institution, detailing the issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series E. The filing includes information about two specific securities: Auto Callable Access Securities linked to the S&P 500® Index and the iShares® Russell 2000 Index Fund, both due on March 3, 2014. The notes were priced on February 28, 2012, with settlement on March 2, 2012. The principal amounts issued were $8,925,000 and $4,738,000, respectively. The filing also includes legal opinions from Norton Rose Canada LLP and Morrison & Foerster LLP regarding the validity of the notes under Canadian and New York law. The report was signed by authorized officers of the Royal Bank of Canada on March 2, 2012.
